protocol.scope: Frozen-codec engineering pilot; not a formal experiment or SOTA claim

data.reserved_images: kodim17..kodim24; do not inspect results during P1
data.preprocessing: EXIF transpose, RGB, Pillow BICUBIC resize to 128x128; deliberately development data, not a Kodak leaderboard protocol

protocol.trajectory_scope: Three nonoverlapping segments of the released channel trace with independent additive-noise seeds; not three independently regenerated propagation traces
protocol.timing_scope: Fixed 0.125 ms diagnostic gap. No API latency. Actual channel trace advances. Diagnostic is optimistic and not an end-to-end latency claim.
protocol.enhancement_input: Original 64x64 quadrant upsampled bilinearly to 128x128, or original full image; independent C64 encoding
protocol.primary_fusion: alpha=0.5: equal blend with current reconstruction, only in the selected region for ROI
protocol.secondary_fusion: alpha=1.0: replacement, reported separately without oracle selection across fusion rules
protocol.noise_coupling: Common complex Gaussian noise on an absolute local trace timeline across counterfactual actions and widths; independent between image/condition/trajectory units
protocol.metric: MSE on [0,1] RGB, PSNR from floating reconstructions clipped to [0,1], LPIPS normalize=True
protocol.oracle: Hindsight argmin realized MSE, including stop; diagnosis only, never available to deployed policy
protocol.upper_bound: Perfect replacement of one quadrant from the original image, no noise/cost; geometric diagnostic only
protocol.primary_headroom_threshold: At least 5% mean MSE reduction versus the best fixed feasible action on the development set; this is an engineering threshold, not a significance claim
protocol.single_round_gate: If oracle still cannot match matched-payload single-round performance, do not launch full selector training for this codec; missing overhead makes the two-round comparison optimistic
